in_arabic.name: Behnaz
in_arabic.long_meaning: Behnaz هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Persian words 'beh' (in the grace of) and 'naz' (beautiful, adorned). It signifies a person who is blessed and graced with beauty.
